title: Froghop family addendum
description: Froghop source mechanisms and their mapping limits. The shared executable conditional compiler is defined in the base grammar.

definitions.parent: A source commit with retained settings, schedules, credits, and nonce.
definitions.target: A pinned parent plus the declared measured-cleanup policy edit.

rules.title: Edit the Froghop history schedule
rules.description: The inherited constructor and its schedule tables define how walk choices are stored and replayed. A schedule edit must keep each history use and cleanup consistent.

mechanism.match: The inherited one- or double-path schedule and history representation.
mechanism.replace: A source-backed alternative schedule with its matching replay.

preserves: The promised point-addition map on admitted inputs.
Relative phase on every admitted measurement branch.
Zero final scratch and unchanged classical addend.
rules.cost: Measure Q and T; no fixed improvement is assumed.

notes: Selecting one of the frozen targets changes the inherited large recipe. The fast constructor does not implement a scaled Froghop history schedule.
